title: OGLO Session Report Suite Generator (Completed Phase 1)
description: Generate a standardized folder structure for each NWB session containing report-suite.ipynb (interactive report), report-suite.html (fully compiled HTML export), and figures/svg/ (vector exports of all generated figures).

title: OGLO Report Suite Improvement (Phase 2)
description: Expand and compile the report suite to include exactly 10 comprehensive analyses with correct, visually valid SVG exports using the Madelane Golden Dark palette. Ensure precise coordinates, axis formatting, legends, and labels for all figures.

title: SVM Preprocessing (Baseline Subtraction & Normalization)
description: Expose baseline-subtraction parameters to normalize trial spike count vectors (e.g. subtracting pre-stimulus interval baseline firing rates) before training the SVM classifier to control for state fluctuations.

title: Interactive Granger Causality Network Visualization
description: Develop an interactive directed graph visualization using Plotly in `jnwb/viz.py` that maps inter-area Granger causality causality flow as edge thickness, permitting dynamic node dragging and hover inspections.

title: GPU-Accelerated Population Trajectory (PCA)
description: Utilize PyTorch or JAX Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on GPU to accelerate population trajectory dimensionality reduction (PCA) across thousands of active neurons.
